description: Deterministic chart / PDF / Word / Excel file builders for the chat agent -- a component with mcp_server_resource_key that registers a stdio MCP server any agent (OpenAI/Anthropic/LiteLLM/Gemini) can call to make_chart / make_pdf / make_docx / make_xlsx from data it already has. No network, no credentials.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under

files_dir.label: Files Dir
files_dir.description: Local directory root for generated files, one subfolder per dagster/run_id. Create it with write access for whichever process runs the chat agent.

max_file_bytes.label: Max File Bytes
max_file_bytes.description: Per-file size cap in bytes. A file over this is rejected, not truncated.

max_files_per_run.label: Max Files Per Run
max_files_per_run.description: Max files a single run (dagster/run_id) may generate across all tools.

file_retention_hours.label: File Retention Hours
file_retention_hours.description: A run's generated files (and its manifest) are deleted this many hours after they were written -- swept opportunistically on each tool call, not a scheduled job.

run_id_template.label: Run Id Template
run_id_template.description: Template for the REPORT_TOOLS_RUN_ID env var set on the stdio MCP server (mcp_server_resource_key only) -- left as the literal string '{run_id}' here; the CALLING agent's own generic {run_id}/{tag.*} substitution resolves it to the real run id before the subprocess is spawned (same mechanism as knowledge_search_server's run_id_template). This is what scopes every generated file and its manifest to the run that made it, so slack_reply / teams_reply only ever post files from their OWN run.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings -- python -m this module, with REPORT_TOOLS_* env vars set from files_dir/allow/max_file_bytes/max_files_per_run/file_retention_hours/run_id_template. DAGSTER_HOME, DAGSTER_CLOUD_DEPLOYMENT_NAME, and anything listed in mcp_extra_env_vars are read fresh from the environment at run time, not baked in at component load. Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy (read fresh every time a consumer resolves the resource) from this process into the spawned MCP server's env.

name: report_tools_server
